window: Tuesday, 7:30 pm to 11:00 pm, after the IFT222 lessons
goal: Module One of the course text, which is compulsory written question one and the whole of objective test 1: the analyst, the life cycle and the methodologies. It goes tonight so Friday is not left with the whole course. Finish on the practical, choosing and justifying a methodology.
drill: The methodology selection table is the single most examined thing in this module. Say it back from memory before you sleep.

window: Wednesday, 6:30 pm to 11:00 pm, after the IFT222 paper
goal: Module Two of the course text, compulsory written question two and the heaviest diagram work: fact-finding, use cases, data flow diagrams and entity relationship diagrams. Draw each diagram by hand as you meet it, then the practical; this is a drawing paper.
drill: Twenty-one of test 2's thirty questions sit here, and ten of them are matching. Learn definitions BESIDE their names, not names alone.

window: Friday, 12:30 pm to 2:30 pm, after the Java paper
goal: Module Three of the course text, compulsory written question three: objects, class diagrams and the behavioural diagrams, then the hotel booking practical. Finish on the cram sheet, which also brings back the lists from Modules One and Two. Eat something first.
drill: Include against extend, aggregation against composition, sequence against collaboration. Three pairs, and all three get asked. The trap list last, then leave for the hall.

window: Only if you finish early: past papers and extra practice, not required
goal: Both past papers and three practice papers, all in the older shape. Your paper is three compulsory questions, one per module, so treat each question as practice on its module and draw every diagram by hand.
drill: If you have any spare minutes at all, sketch Question One of the 2025/2026 paper.
